report: The face-turning cuboctahedron printed and built well. The square faces are not very easy to turn.
future_shape_proposal: The dual body, a vertex-turning rhombic dodecahedron, may offer better grip around each turning axis. This is a proposed future shape, not a designed or tested replacement.
scope: Successful physical printing and assembly, with a qualitative square-face turning difficulty. No measured turning torque, isolated cause, wear or endurance result was reported.
provenance: The owner identified the face-turning cuboctahedron. Hashes identify the supplied v1 puzzle STLs associated with that report; the exact slicer input files and optional core selection were not independently verified.

hardware.washer: 14 x 7 mm OD x 0.5 mm thick, M3 clearance

print_settings.prior_setup: Bambu Lab P1S, 0.4 mm nozzle; PLA used for previous builds.
